_, meta, body = s.split('---\\n', 2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
roman_blocks = [b.splitlines() for b in roman.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
source_blocks = [b.splitlines() for b in body.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert len(roman_blocks) == len(source_blocks) == 12
for n, (r, u) in enumerate(zip(roman_blocks, source_blocks)):
    assert len(r) == len(u)
    if n:
        assert r[0].strip() == str(n)
        assert u[0] == str(n).translate(str.maketrans('0123456789', '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'))
assert '\\ufffd' not in s and '\\u200c' not in s
print('Verified preamble and 11 matching numbered blocks.')
PY"
